ayahs.text: الٓر تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translation: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading

ayahs.text: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims

ayahs.text: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know

ayahs.text: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
ayahs.translation: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it

ayahs.text: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind

ayahs.text: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.translation: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman

ayahs.text: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful

ayahs.text: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
ayahs.translation: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated

ayahs.text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translation: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old

ayahs.text: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.translation: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him

ayahs.text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty

ayahs.text: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translation: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before

ayahs.text: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
ayahs.translation: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it

ayahs.text: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
ayahs.translation: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.translation: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders

ayahs.text: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil

ayahs.text: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translation: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue

ayahs.text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
ayahs.translation: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein

ayahs.text: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not

ayahs.text: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
ayahs.translation: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure

ayahs.text: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ
ayahs.translation: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
ayahs.translation: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.translation: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
ayahs.translation: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered

ayahs.text: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.translation: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire

ayahs.text: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
ayahs.translation: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered

ayahs.text: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.translation: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him

ayahs.text: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
ayahs.translation: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together

ayahs.text: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.translation: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate

ayahs.text: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.translation: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate

ayahs.text: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
ayahs.translation: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
ayahs.translation: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment

ayahs.text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.translation: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.translation: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved

ayahs.text: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
ayahs.translation: Till the Day of appointed time

ayahs.text: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.translation: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one

ayahs.text: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.translation: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves

ayahs.text: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.translation: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me

ayahs.text: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.translation: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place

ayahs.text: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
ayahs.translation: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.translation: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings

ayahs.text: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.translation: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure

ayahs.text: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.translation: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised

ayahs.text: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
ayahs.translation: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence

ayahs.text: نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.translation: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful

ayahs.text: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
ayahs.translation: And that My doom is the dolorous doom

ayahs.text: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.translation: And tell them of Abraham's guests

ayahs.text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
ayahs.translation: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom

ayahs.text: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
ayahs.translation: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
ayahs.translation: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing

ayahs.text: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
ayahs.translation: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray

ayahs.text: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk

ayahs.text: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.translation: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one

ayahs.text: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.translation: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind

ayahs.text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot

ayahs.text: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me)

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing

ayahs.text: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.translation: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers

ayahs.text: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
ayahs.translation: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded

ayahs.text: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.translation: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn

ayahs.text: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
ayahs.translation: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals)

ayahs.text: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
ayahs.translation: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not

ayahs.text: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
ayahs.translation: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.translation: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone

ayahs.text: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.translation: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so)

ayahs.text: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayahs.translation: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death

ayahs.text: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
ayahs.translation: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise

ayahs.text: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
ayahs.translation: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
ayahs.translation: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers

ayahs.text: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers

ayahs.text: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.translation: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.translation: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers

ayahs.text: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.translation: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them

ayahs.text: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.translation: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure

ayahs.text: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.translation: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour

ayahs.text: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.translation: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not

ayahs.text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
ayahs.translation: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness

ayahs.text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.translation: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
ayahs.translation: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an

ayahs.text: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.translation: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers

ayahs.text: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.translation: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner

ayahs.text: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
ayahs.translation: Such as We send down for those who make division

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
ayahs.translation: Those who break the Qur'an into parts

ayahs.text: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.translation: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one

ayahs.text: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.translation: Of what they used to do

ayahs.text: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayahs.translation: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters

ayahs.text: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.translation: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
ayahs.translation: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say

ayahs.text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.translation: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him)

ayahs.text: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
ayahs.translation: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee
